//: Every version in this repo lives in gradle/libs.versions.toml; doctor.py fails on a coordinate written anywhere else, so the version catalog manager is the only one that has anything to do. One pull request a week, every update in it: one CI run and one review rather than twenty.

packageRules.description: Every dependency in one pull request. A bump that breaks the build is held back in that pull request, not split into a group of its own.
A template should start on stable. Pre-release versions are opened only when the catalog already holds one.
